Arun vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 August, 2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Ind:21443
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Gajendra Singh
 On The 6 th Of August, 2025
 Criminal Appeal No. 84 of 2016
 Arun
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Ravi Sagre - learned counsel for the appellant.

Shri Rajesh Joshi - G.A appearing on behalf of A.G..
 Order

This Criminal Appeal under Section 374 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is preferred challenging the judgment dated 30.09.2015 in S.T.No.32/2015 by the First ASJ, Shajapur whereby appellant/accused has been convicted under Sections 366A, 376(2)(N) of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo 03 years R.I and 10 years R.I and fine of Rs.10,000/- & Rs.10,000/- with default stipulation.

2. This appeal arises out of the incident dated 13.12.2014 in which accused abducted the minor girl (prosecutrix) and committed rape with her and regarding which a Crime No.08/2015 was registered at Police Station Shajapur, District - Shajapur.
3.

The PUD No.1795/Warrant/2024 dated 22.07.2024 of Jail Superintendent, District Jail, Shajapur mentions that the appellant/accused has been released on 30.03.2023 after completing the sentence and NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:21443 2 CRA-84-2016 depositing the fine amount.

4. Perusal of the prosecution evidence and judgment of the trial Court does not discloses any error in appreciation of evidence and conviction of the appellant/accused, hence, the conviction is affirmed.
The sentence is proportionate and that has been undergone, accordingly, no case for interference in the sentence is required.
5. In view of the aforesaid, this criminal appeal is dismissed.
6. Copy of the order along with record be sent to the concerned trial court for information.
